key: # The pictures the middle of the wheel can hold.  config.csv's center_svg
# names one by key (or `auto`, for the tradition's own, from its
# tradition.csv), and the page offers them all in its Artwork menu.  Each
# one's author, license and source are shown with it; see artwork/CREDITS.md.
# `attribution` = required: the license asks for credit wherever the picture
# is shown, so the drawing carries it too (see artwork_credit in config.csv).
# `owner`: a church's own emblem, credited to the church; a church using its
# own emblem may leave the credit off (page_footer = none).
# `scale` sizes a picture inside the circle (blank = 1, filling its width or
# height).  Each is set so the picture's farthest point reaches 92% of the way
# to the month ring; the round seals (blank) fill the circle exactly.
